policy: Synthetic learners for every simulated arm. One real dataset is used (decision D-011, protocol section 14): the Duolingo half-life regression traces calibrate the median initial half-life h0 on a fit user split and give a preregistered second test of the forgetting model on a held-out user split. The real data never enters a simulated arm or contrast. Raw and processed real data are git-ignored and never committed (over 20 MB; pseudonymous user ids at row level).
